Private Asset Management Inc decreased its stake in Apple Inc (AAPL) by 20.36% based on its latest 2018Q3 regulatory filing with the SEC. Private Asset Management Inc who had been investing in Apple Inc for a number of months, seems to be less bullish one the $811.23 billion market cap company. The stock decreased 1.09% or $3.77 during the last trading session, reaching $170.95. About 21,624 shares traded. Apple Inc. (NASDAQ:AAPL) has risen 0.17% since December 14, 2017 and is uptrending. It has outperformed by 0.17% the S&P500.
Analysts await Apple Inc. (NASDAQ:AAPL) to report earnings on February, 7. They expect $4.74 EPS, up 21.85 % or $0.85 from last year’s $3.89 per share.
